results.title: Climate change could cut Cambodia’s GDP by nearly 10% by 2050
results.description: Climate change could reduce Cambodia’s gross domestic product (GDP) by 2.5% by 2030 and as much as 9.8% by 2050, while the country remains highly vulnerable to floods, droughts, storms, heatwaves and seawater intrusion, according to the Ministry of Environment.
